about:
NorthWoods Manufacturing was founded in 2005 in Lancaster, New Hampshire. The company operates as a custom cabinet shop serving residential and commercial clients across northern New Hampshire, northern Vermont, and western Massachusetts.

The shop produces custom kitchens, bathroom vanities, countertops, and closet systems, and also offers CNC machining services for cabinet components. With a team of eleven skilled craftsmen, NorthWoods uses computer-controlled equipment to cut and fabricate parts, supplying both finished cabinets shipped throughout the United States and Canada and raw components to other cabinet shops that outsource cutting to control costs and quality.

Customers range from local homeowners and custom builders to commercial contractors; notable projects include a kitchenette for North Country Ford in Lancaster, cabinetry for Weeks Medical Center, and CNC-machined parts for B.O.H. Interiors. The company also partners with cabinet shops nationwide that rely on NorthWoods for precision-cut components.

NorthWoods emphasizes that all products are manufactured in its Lancaster facility, positioning itself as a one-stop source for design, fabrication, and delivery. The business grew from a focus on thoughtful, affordable design and aims to give clients a kitchen they “love,” not just one they are happy with.
